props.name: headerTag
props.description:
Element to render for the header element inside the expandable panel.
'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'h5' and 'h6' is valid.

props.name: id
props.description:
The id for the content id attribute.
If the prop is not set the id will be generated.

props.name: notifications
props.description:
Number of notifications present in panel.

If set to zero (default) no notification badge will be displayed.

props.name: screenReaderNotificationTemplate
props.description:
Text template for the screen reader notification text.
Use `%VALUE%` as a placeholder for the number of notifications.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Emitted when panel heading is clicked.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Slot used for content shown when panel is expanded

slots.name: outside
slots.description: Slot used for optional content rendered below panel when expanded
